facts.fact: ICASA, the regulator, received 33 responses, including from ISPA, Cell C, Vodacom and Amatole Telecommunications, to phase one of its inquiry into new network licences, which the minister directed in August 2025.
facts.system: ICASA inquiry into new I-ECNS licences

facts.fact: ICASA's discussion document, published in the Government Gazette on 30 October 2026, sets out a wrap-up of the phase-one submissions and its preliminary view, and invites comments until 6 January with public hearings still to come.

systems.system: ICASA inquiry into new I-ECNS licences
